shared_elements: standing human figures in strict profile
procession/file of overlapping figures facing one direction
long fringed garments with patterned hems
figures holding staff- or rod-like objects
figures carrying/holding small objects in extended hands
low-relief figures set in a horizontal register
justification: Both show a file of bearded human figures in strict profile, overlapping one another, wearing long fringed robes and holding staffs or small offerings, rendered in shallow relief with the same patterned treatment of beard, hair and garment hem. The main difference in content is that A includes a large camel led by the attendants and framing bands of rosettes, while B is a close-set group of large-scale figures (one apparently with a horned or winged attribute) with no animal or ornamental border.
